ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels concentrated in mottled patterns and focal points accounting for the remaining 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Single contiguous black region across both lobes; diffuse white mottling and stippling concentrated on the distal third of the right lobe; sparse white punctate spots (<10px diameter) distributed across the medial and right-central fluke regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 40-45 degrees; central depression depth is roughly 1/6th of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical serration pattern; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher frequency, irregular jagged peaks and valleys; the left lobe trailing edge displays a more consistent, low-amplitude sawtooth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to distal tips; the leading edge (bottom) follows a broad, smooth convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-10 distinct instances) observed on the right lobe and central region, characteristic of localized surface scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal linear disruptions visible on the right lobe surface, oriented toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, high-contrast textured clusters of barnacle colonization (Cirripedia) at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray and particulate disruption visible at the lower boundary where the fluke meets the water surface, creating a localized high-frequency texture.
